originalPaper.citation: Kashdan, T. B., Disabato, D. J., Goodman, F. R., & McKnight, P. E. (2020). The Five-Dimensional Curiosity Scale Revised (5DCR): Briefer subscales while separating overt and covert social curiosity. Personality and Individual Differences, 157, 109836.
originalPaper.fulltext_status: Read full author-linked manuscript including Appendix and scoring; free to read, NOT claimed openly licensed.
originalPaper.order_note: Original Appendix places Thrill Seeking before social facets and orders overt social items differently. This package pins GESIS 2022 order, not original 2020 presentation order.
originalPaper.population: US working adults N=483 and community sample N=460; not a schoolchild norm.

validationDocument.citation: Grüning, D. J., & Lechner, C. M. (online 2022; print 2023). Measuring Six Facets of Curiosity in Germany and the UK: A German-Language Adaptation of the 5DCR and Its Comparability with the English-Language Source Version. Journal of Personality Assessment, 105(2), 283–295.
validationDocument.fulltext_access: 403, not bypassed; official 16-page technical excerpt read and available for backup.
validationDocument.sample: UK native-English adults N=483, ages 18–69, mean 44, SD 15; 51.2% female; two-week retest N=182.
validationDocument.invariance: At least partial scalar invariance reported across examined age, sex, education and UK/Germany comparisons; not evidence of Chinese equivalence.

chineseEvidence.package_status: AI initial translation, unvalidated; independent bilingual review pending.
chineseEvidence.citation: Tian, Y., Huang, Q., Liu, X., Zhang, J., Ye, Y., & Wu, H. (online 2024; print 2025). Unraveling the Intricacies of Curiosity: A Comprehensive Study of Its Measures in the Chinese Context. PsyCh Journal, 14(2), 219–234.
chineseEvidence.sample: N=723, ages 18–53, mean 22.11 (SD 4.35); 455 women; 654 students and 69 employed.
chineseEvidence.evidence: Six-factor 5DCR: CFI .89, TLI .88, RMSEA .06, SRMR .05; authors retained six factors despite CFI/TLI below .90. Facet omegas .732–.842.
chineseEvidence.version_rights: Study translation prepared/proofread by first five authors. Exact translation rights and correspondence to this AI draft not established; no copying of that Chinese text, no transfer of its validity to this draft.
chineseEvidence.equivalence: No English/Chinese equivalence or Chinese norms claimed.
